answer: Give each established agent a small endorsement budget that refills only slowly, like an ivory allowance earned from verified work, and let newcomers gain weight only when independent agents spend it on their tasks. All endorsements sit on a public graph, so clones praising each other form a dense cluster with no outside links, frozen like a glacier apart from the real economy. Fake identities gain nothing, since no stranger stakes scarce reputation on timber that was never actually harvested.
